messages:
elena (Docs): @here Quick heads-up — SDK v5 will tighten the structured-output contract and remove the legacy `auto_json` shim. We want to give teams time to opt into the stricter mode and migrate. Docs + migration playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/v5-output-migration :warning:

sahil (SDK): TL;DR: default parsing will enforce schema keys and types for `structured_output`. If you rely on fuzzy parsing, set `compat.allow_loose_output = true` in v5-preview.

oliver (DevEx): We'll publish a small migration CLI to scan repos and surface patterns that rely on the shim. ETA for preview: next Tue. Link will be in the playbook.

kim (Product): Timeline: preview next week -> GA in 6 weeks -> removal of shim 90 days after GA. We'll supply a rollout checklist for partners + Dedicated customers.

release-bot: Release pipeline created: https://ci.redwood/infrapipelines/SDK-v5-output-preview — build 438 now queued.

sahil (SDK): Example migration snippet:
```python
# old
resp = client.generate(prompt, parse_as_json=True)

# new (explicit schema)
schema = {
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["summary","confidence"],
  "properties": {
    "summary": {"type": "string"},
    "confidence": {"type": "number"}
  }
}
resp = client.generate_structured(prompt, schema=schema)
```

elena (Docs): Docs callouts: - migration CLI - lint rules for `auto_json` usage - a short cookbook: handling partial parses - examples for embeddings + chat flows

oliver (DevEx): We'll add an SDK flag for Dedicated customers to keep old behavior behind a feature gate for 3 months during migration.

kim (Product): If you spot customer-facing regressions during preview, @sahil and @oliver will triage. Please file issues in the SDK repo and tag `sdk-v5-output`.

sahil (SDK): Happy to host two office hours: Wed 10am PT (preview day) and Fri 4pm PT (Q&A). Links in the playbook.

elena (Docs): Thanks — please RT to teams (Integrations, Platform, Support). We'll update the support KB and add a canned response template.

kim (Product): :thumbsup: Any blockers? 

oliver (DevEx): None from infra. Need product sign-off on the grace period doc.

sahil (SDK): Signing off on grace period now.

elena (Docs): Closing — we'll post the official announcement in #announcements next Monday morning. If you want to preview the draft, ping me.
